text: Database queries are written as TypeScript functions that execute directly inside the database
quote: Convex is the open source, reactive database where queries are TypeScript code running right in the database.

text: Convex's backend is open source
quote: Convex is the open source, reactive database where queries are TypeScript code running right in the database.

text: Schemas are optional but, when defined, enforce that data matches an exact shape
quote: Though optional, schemas ensure that your data looks exactly how you want.

text: First-party Clerk integration provides auth support for Next.js and React Native apps
quote: Clerk has great Next.js and React Native support

text: Convex Auth library lets you build custom sign-up/sign-in flows via social login, one-time email/SMS codes, or passwords
quote: you can implement auth directly in Convex with the Convex Auth library... helps you build a custom sign-up/sign-in flow via social identity providers, one-time email or SMS access codes, or via passwords.

text: CLI dev server watches local files and pushes function/schema changes live to your dev deployment
quote: Watches the local filesystem. When you change a function or the schema, the new versions are pushed to your dev deployment

text: Generated TypeScript types in convex/_generated update automatically whenever schema or functions change
quote: Watches the local filesystem. When you change a function or the schema, the new versions are pushed to your dev deployment and the generated types in convex/_generated are updated.

text: Vector search finds documents similar to a given embedding vector, useful for LLM context and recommendations
quote: Vector search allows you to find Convex documents similar to a provided vector... enable you to provide useful context to LLMs for AI powered applications, recommendations for similar content and more.

text: You can self-host the full open-source Convex backend on your own servers, same code as the cloud service
quote: you can run the Convex backend on your own servers. Self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend, and contains the same fully up-to-date code the cloud service uses.

text: Self-hosted Convex works with common infra providers like Neon, Fly.io, Vercel, Netlify, RDS, Postgres, and Sqlite
quote: Self-hosted Convex works well with a variety of tools including Neon, Fly.io, Vercel, Netlify, RDS, Sqlite, Postgres, and more.

text: Public functions are automatically exposed as callable HTTP endpoints
quote: The public functions that define a deployment are exposed at public HTTP endpoints.

text: Official MCP server exposes tools that let AI agents interact directly with your Convex deployment
quote: The Convex Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides several tools that allow AI agents to interact with your Convex deployment.

text: Convex Components are sandboxed, open-source building blocks you can add for complex functionality
quote: Convex Components are sandboxed, open-source building blocks for your app. They let you add complex functionality to your app without implementing everything from scratch.

text: ACID transactions ensure concurrent writes never corrupt your data
quote: ACID transactions so concurrent writes never corrupt your data

text: Tables spring into existence automatically on first document insert, with no upfront schema or table setup required
quote: Your Convex deployment contains tables that hold your app's data. Initially, your deployment contains no tables or documents. Each table springs into existence as soon as you add the first document to it.

text: Provides an agent-setup guide (agent-setup.md) to make coding agents Convex-aware
quote: Make your agent a Convex expert: Get Convex-ready by following https://www.convex.dev/agent-setup.md

text: Real-time sync pushes the latest data to connected users instantly
quote: Real-time sync so your users instantly see the latest data

text: Convex is designed to work smoothly with coding agents for scaffolding and building new apps
quote: Convex works great with coding agents. Starting a new project is as easy as asking your agent to create a new app with Convex.

text: Doesn't force an opinionated RLS-style framework; you can build custom authorization logic in code
quote: Convex doesn't need an opinionated authorization framework like RLS, which is required in client oriented databases like Firebase or Supabase.

text: CLI can run any public or internal query, mutation, or action against your dev deployment
quote: npx convex run <functionName> [args] — Run a public or internal Convex query, mutation, or action on your development deployment.

text: CLI supports importing data from a file directly into a deployment
quote: `npx convex import` — Import data from a file to your deployment

text: CLI can display health insights about your deployment
quote: `npx convex insights` — Show health insights for your deployment

text: MCP server blocks access to production deployments by default as a safety measure
quote: By default, the MCP server cannot access production deployments. This is a safety measure to prevent accidental modifications to production data.

text: End-to-end type safety helps catch AI-agent coding mistakes before they ship
quote: End-to-end type safety so agent hallucinations are caught before they ship
